conflicts.permit: FingerFun(HK) Limited will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy and no transfer of your Personal Data will take place to an organization or a country unless there are adequate controls in place including the security of your data and other personal information.
conflicts.prohibit: For the purpose of analysis service, TalkingData analysis service will send above data to TalkingData server through your application, and display in convergent data and analysis report.
conflicts.situation: A user's personal data is transferred through the application to TalkingData's servers without establishing adequate security controls or agreements.
conflicts.reason: Section 10.1 mandates automatic data collection and transmission to TalkingData servers, while Section 11.3 unconditionally prohibits transfers lacking verified adequate controls without resolving precedence.
